name: OKP Holdings Limited
summary: OKP Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiary, operates as a transport infrastructure and civil engineering company in Singapore and Australia. The company operates through three segments: Construction, Maintenance, and Rental income from investment properties. The Construction segment constructs urban and arterial roads, airport runways and taxiways, expressways, vehicular bridges, flyovers, buildings, airports infrastructure, and oil and gas-related infrastructure for petrochemical plants and oil storage terminals.
